privacy: Generated UI fixtures only. No target captures accessed. This record contains no images or target OCR.

request_settings.result: All requests in this record returned valid JSON in normal final content; no reasoning-channel adapter was used.

load_observations.note: Loading is excluded from request wall time. These are single observations, not controlled cold-start distributions.

method: All model requests were serialized. First requests are excluded from warm summaries.
Wall time covers request serialization, HTTP and full response parsing; fixture generation, JPEG encoding and data-URL construction are excluded.
Initial fixture indices 0..12 were reused across tasks; those cells are retained separately from the unseen-frame comparison.
Unseen modal-only cells use actual indices 1000..1008 at width 960 and 2000..2008 at width 1920. Indices were new to each evaluated model.
The wrapper applies an index offset. Raw fixture_index values are local indices; request_profile.actual_fixture_indices gives the actual generator indices.
Each unseen warm cell has two positive and six negative modal examples. All are simple high-contrast generated screens.
Benchmark instructions define a modal versus a full-page card; other caller prompts and applications require separate accuracy checks.
The wrapper gained offset/filter options after the initial cells. Per-run profiles retain the source hashes and effective request settings at execution.
These are component inference measurements, not complete MCP, capture, controller or task cycles. Small samples do not establish tail latency or production accuracy.

cache_observation.description: This exact state request repeated the earlier probe. Subsequent changing requests took 2151.103..2345.985 ms. The repeated request is not an unseen-frame latency estimate.
